findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is an endpoint pointcloud with a detached FLOWR endpoint VJP, so coordinate contrasts are not physical interaction energies or affinity-head derivatives.

Continuous contrast functions over the observed window are non-monotone: landmark local-coordinate features show multiple sign changes (e.g. 6-10 sign changes) with large first-vs-last rate z-scores of opposite sign, and no polynomial fit is accepted, so a constant rule is not supported and any time-conditioned rule must stay within observed-node interpolation without extrapolation.

Joint selection-innovation diagnostics show a coherent, null-tested positive association between innovation and native alignment (q~2.2e-9, positive batch fraction 1.0) and a coherent negative association with observed child score gain (q~1.8e-7, positive batch fraction 0.0), indicating that selection-time innovation is coupled to native alignment but anti-coupled to immediate observed child score gain.

Teacher-contrast coherence is high (whole-window mean ~0.81) and teacher control root ESS is ~1.30, so the supplied teacher contrast signal is internally coherent rather than a set of incompatible marginal descriptors; this supports treating joint coordinate patterns as the unit of evidence rather than isolated marginals.

hypotheses.falsifier: No observed-node sign agreement above chance, or sign changes not reproducible across independent batches.
hypotheses.observable: sign and magnitude of landmark local-coordinate contrast at observed score nodes
hypotheses.scope: observed window [0.0,0.5], observed score nodes only
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned coordinate contrast rule that follows the observed-node sign of the landmark local-coordinate contrast (rather than a constant rule) will better track the observed selection-node contrasts over the observed window.

hypotheses.falsifier: Turnover accounting showing the association is explained by parent reweighting or reclassification rather than within-path increments.
hypotheses.statement: Selection-time innovation that is coherent with native alignment but anti-coupled to immediate observed child score gain reflects a within-path change rather than a changing cohort composition.

limitations: No decoded terminal labels or final affinity outcomes are supplied, so last-record or selection credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit; the immediate-vs-descendant comparison is unavailable.
Continuous contrast curves are not absolute reward targets and no extrapolation is permitted; only observed-node interpolation is supported.
Joint diagnostics are descriptive within-selector associations with batch as the independent unit; they are not causal selection effects or atom velocities.
No temperature edit is permitted and none is proposed; the incumbent FLOWR endpoint, reference and integrator bindings are preserved.

task.formula: R=tau*logsumexp(log_pi-rho_delta(q)/tau), q=detached-Hungarian endpoint mean squared distance; rho_delta=delta^2*(sqrt(1+q/delta^2)-1). Actual pointcloud_delta_A defaults to 1 A. Native endpoint VJP, no affinity-head derivative, no extra model forward. teacher_neighbors is a count; temporal_recipe changes only a registered scalar/attention, not velocity. No temperature edits. Inert legacy metadata is not a reward term.

formula_registry.diagnostic_limit: Moment effects, pair kernels and turnover are diagnostic evidence. Executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term; legacy robust_delta is inert.
formula_registry.dose: Endpoint-VJP force normalized and RMS-scaled against native predictive update; eta/ramp only in U lane.
formula_registry.prior: Detached nearest-k teachers; log_pi=-q_anchor/prior_temperature; scores beta=0; k is a count.
formula_registry.regional: Detached background plus Gaussian landmark attention; positive surrounding weight.
formula_registry.temporal_region: Same static teachers; validated absolute contrast changes regional attention at observed score nodes.
formula_registry.temporal_teacher: (1-blend)*R_static + blend*R_observed_teacher(time); same shared FLOWR endpoint, no velocity target.

incumbent.topology_policy: Free native graph transitions; no pair-distance acceptance or graph equality veto

task.objective: Final predicted target affinity primary; validity and strain secondary; coordinate control only
task.task_wording: Interpret the supplied evidence and answer the coordinate-design task.
